clues: This town sits on a river in the north of South Africa's Western Cape. Cape Town lies far to its south.
Two weather zones meet here. Winters are mild with some rain, but summers can be very hot and dry.
It was laid out in 1933. It was part of a river scheme that brought water to dry farm land.
In October 2015, this town had the hottest day on the whole Earth for that month. People still talk about that fierce heat.
This town is the main hub for trade and town services in the north of its river valley. It serves the north of the whole province too.
